statement: let w := fun k : ℕ => if Nat.Prime k then Real.log (k:ℝ) else 0; let E := fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (((2*Real.pi*x:ℝ):ℂ)*Complex.I); let S := fun (n : ℕ) (u : ℕ → ℝ) (t : ℝ) => Finset.sum (Finset.range (n+1)) (fun k => (u k:ℂ)*E ((k:ℝ)*t)); let Q := fun n : ℕ => (Nat.log 2 (n+2))^2; let f := fun (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ) => (S n w t)^2*E (-(n:ℝ)*t); let Q₁ := fun n : ℕ => ⌊(n:ℝ)^(1/3:ℝ)⌋₊; let H := fun n : ℕ => 256 * Q₁ n * Q n; let wideArcs := fun n : ℕ => {t : ℝ | ∃ q a : ℕ, 1≤q ∧ q≤Q₁ n ∧ a≤q ∧ Nat.Coprime a q ∧ |t-(a:ℝ)/(q:ℝ)| ≤ (H n:ℝ)/((q:ℝ)*(n:ℝ))}; let Q₂ := fun n : ℕ => ⌊Real.sqrt (n : ℝ) / ((Nat.log 2 (n + 2) : ℝ) ^ 4)⌋₊; let sqrtArcs := fun n : ℕ => {t : ℝ | ∃ q a : ℕ, 1 ≤ q ∧ q ≤ Q₂ n ∧ a ≤ q ∧ Nat.Coprime a q ∧ |t - (a : ℝ) / (q : ℝ)| ≤ ((256 * Q₂ n * Q n : ℕ) : ℝ) / ((q : ℝ) * (n : ℝ))}; ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → Q₁ n ≤ Q₂ n → let old := {t : ℝ | ∃ q a : ℕ, 1 ≤ q ∧ q ≤ Q₁ n ∧ a ≤ q ∧ Nat.Coprime a q ∧ |t-(a:ℝ)/q| ≤ ((256*Q₂ n*Q n:ℕ):ℝ)/((q:ℝ)*n)}; let J := fun A : Set ℝ => intervalIntegral (fun t => A.indicator (f n) t) (0:ℝ) 1 MeasureTheory.volume; J ((wideArcs n)ᶜ) = J (old \ wideArcs n) + J (sqrtArcs n \ old) + J ((sqrtArcs n)ᶜ)

brief.en: Use the nested measurable masks W⊆old⊆U with the same f. Count new centers only outside old. The parent controls the first two terms. The exterior remains in the original deep coefficient.
